caption: The drawing depicts a copper-colored metal teapot with a rounded, somewhat squat body resting on three thin, curved legs. The teapot has a prominent spout extending from the right side and a decorative, animal-head-shaped spout on the left. The handle is not visible, but the lid on top is domed with a small knob in the center. The metal surface appears aged, with patches of dark tarnish and irregular coloration, including brown, orange, and darker blackish spots. The legs are riveted to the body with visible rounded fasteners and have a slightly rough, corroded appearance. The background is plain and off-white, making the teapot the sole focus of the composition. The artist’s name, Orrie McCombs, is written in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Copper Kettle
